**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
[rivet:bridge] RV2144 {framework} island {id} failed to render: {message}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Fix the error the island's component threw during its server render (the message and `cause` name it), or give the island a `fallback` prop: its server HTML then stands in for the failed island and the page renders.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
// Chart.react.tsx: reads a browser global during render
export function Chart() { return <canvas width={window.innerWidth} />; }
```

```tsx prefer
// page.tsx: server HTML when the island cannot render
<Chart client="visible" fallback={<p>Loading chart…</p>} />
```

## When it is reported

Server render (`@rivetjs/bridge`). The framework adapter threw while rendering the island (component error, a slot hole the framework dropped or duplicated, an unsupported framework version such as RV2150). With a `fallback` prop the fallback renders instead; without one the error goes to the nearest error boundary (route error view).
